adjudication.candidate_coexistence: at least half of primary semantic edges have median early effective neighbourhood count >= 1.5
adjudication.concentration: raw and z-score-control upper 95% bounds for emergence-minus-early normalized neighbourhood entropy are below zero
adjudication.convergence: raw and z-score-control upper 95% bounds for the within-fact versus control early-to-emergence JS difference-in-differences are below zero
adjudication.full_support: candidate_coexistence AND concentration AND localization AND convergence
adjudication.interval: relation-stratified cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 1398100529, percentile 95% interval
adjudication.localization: observed median concentration-to-emergence site distance is below the 1st percentile of the localization null
adjudication.localization_null: relation-stratified permutation of sealed emergence landmarks across semantic edges, 10000 trials, same seed

candidate_space.global_distribution: restricted softmax over all 126 frozen destination token IDs
candidate_space.raw_distribution: softmax of prepared readout logits at temperature 1
candidate_space.scale_control: softmax of per-state candidate-logit z-scores; zero variance refuses
candidate_space.subject_neighbourhood: conditional distribution over every frozen outgoing destination of the row subject
candidate_space.token_semantics: first next-token destination; no multi-token continuation claim

claim_boundary: observational candidate-basin concentration and prompt-path convergence; not quantum collapse, causal redundancy, or proof that decoded token basins are the model's native transition ontology

primary.rule: subject has at least two distinct frozen semantic destination tokens
primary.statistical_unit: unique (subject, relation, target) semantic edge; prompt families are repeated measures

secondary.rule: single known subject destination; eligible for global convergence but not within-neighbourhood ambiguity

downstream_walk_metric_if_supported: true semantic-basin survival versus candidate count, bytes and depth

frozen_landmarks.concentration_site: adjacent post-write step with the largest decrease in normalized subject-neighbourhood entropy; earliest tie
frozen_landmarks.emergence_state_per_row: the post-write state at the sealed emergence layer and site
frozen_landmarks.late_state: post-FFN state at the final layer
frozen_landmarks.shared_emergence_state_per_semantic_edge: median ordered emergence site across its three prompt rows

metrics.addressability: reported from GW-3A-F and the eight-row audit; never substituted for entropy or support concentration
path_convergence: three-prompt mean pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergence over the global candidate distribution by site
same statistic for frozen same-split/relation/family different-subject-and-target controls
within-fact minus control difference-in-differences from early to shared emergence
physical_distribution: GW-0B top-100 FFN support Jaccard where both prompt rows are eligible
post-write delta cosine by site from sealed delta carriers
semantic_ambiguity: subject-neighbourhood mass in the global restricted distribution
intended-target mass globally and conditional on the subject neighbourhood

state_sequence.post_write_rule: apply the execution record's declared layer_scale before readout
state_sequence.reader: prepared production-selected physical final norm and output head, including multiplier and softcap
state_sequence.source: sealed carrier-after artifacts only; no prompt execution
